subject.title: Heartbeat sessions report 'assistant turn failed before producing content' on model initialization failure

question: Should heartbeat model-initialization failures use only clearer provider diagnostics plus existing model fallback behavior, or should heartbeat get a special retry-on-fallback path?
rationale: The diagnostic split is a clear reliability fix, but automatic fallback retry can change provider routing, cost, model choice, and session-state behavior for existing heartbeat users.

options.title: Classify failures, keep fallback policy explicit
options.body: Classify provider/model initialization errors at the shared failure boundary and rely on existing configured model fallback behavior unless maintainers later approve a heartbeat-specific retry.

options.title: Add heartbeat-specific retry
options.body: Permit a narrow heartbeat retry against a configured fallback model, but require maintainer-approved semantics, upgrade proof, and tests for provider routing and session-state effects.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Land only clearer logging/error classification and leave retry behavior unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Classify failures, keep fallback policy explicit
recommendation.body: Classify provider/model initialization errors at the shared failure boundary and rely on existing configured model fallback behavior unless maintainers later approve a heartbeat-specific retry.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is closest to recent provider fallback/auth-gate work, though sentinel and heartbeat owners should also review the final shape.
